title: Canonical integral-left comparison and its uniqueness
statement: Fix the prime l, coefficient closure Ω, finite-field datum D with l ≠ D.p, finite-type schemes X,Y over D.k, a separated finite-type relative morphism f and a compactification c, as in [lem-sf-exceptional-ring-transport-core-data]. For a finite coefficient field E, an integral operation A and its ambient left realization r, there is a specified natural isomorphism e from A.F followed by finiteTorIntegralInclusion at Y to finiteTorIntegralInclusion at X followed by sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor(c,E). Define e by lifting r followed by sfQcqsCompactSupportRealization through the fully faithful inclusion of integral constructible objects at Y. Its image on every component K is exactly r_K followed by that realization. Every natural isomorphism satisfying this component equation equals e. For any transport datum d, replacing only its integralLeft field by this construction produces a datum satisfying the integral-left component equation.

source.place: Construction 5.25 and Proposition 5.26; agent-expanded fully faithful lift and uniqueness argument for the specified proper/open realization.

proof.text: Compose the supplied ambient left realization with the whiskered proper/open compact-support realization. The inclusion of integral constructible objects is fully faithful, so its right whiskering on the functor category is fully faithful. Apply preimageIso to this composite; no unproved existence witness is chosen.

Apply map_preimage and evaluate at K to prove the displayed equation. Given a second comparison with the same equation, faithfulness gives equality of each component, natural-transformation extensionality gives equality of the hom maps, and Iso.ext gives equality of the isomorphisms. The structure update setting integralLeft equal to this construction preserves all other fields and satisfies the equation by the same component theorem.

proof_origin.place: FullyFaithful.preimageIso, map_preimage, map_injective and cancellation of isomorphisms; specialized by E1 to the supplied compact-support realization.

theorem normalizedIntegralLeft_hom (K : C.{u} l Ω X (.integral E)) :
    (sfIntegralConstructible l E.carrier Y).ι.map
        ((normalizedIntegralLeft l Ω D hl c E A r).hom.app K) =
      r.hom.app K ≫
        (sfQcqsCompactSupportRealization l E.carrier D.k
          (PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit l D hl) c).hom.app
          ((PurCompactSupport.finiteTorIntegralInclusion l E.carrier X).obj K)
